cases.name: issue1059_grazing_bar_union_alpha-1.0_beta30
cases.note: #1059 / WR-410 probe geometry (crates/solidcore/tests/issue_1059_grazing_edge_crossing_probe.rs): box A [0,10]^3 united with a 20 x 4 x 4 bar centred on the origin, tilted -1.0 degrees about y and turned 30 degrees about z, then moved by (5, 5, 8): its top edges pierce A's top face at a shallow angle. At the default fixes (upstream behaviour) this compares the port with the C++; Kernel::fixes.boolean_vertex_by_best_crossing changes the result's last digits here (2026-10-26).
